_meta.notes: *** THE FORM-TITLE YEAR IS NOT THE CYCLE - CONFIRMED AT THE PAGE. *** The cover is printed '2016 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate', but this document is the 2017 YEAR-END report: the Year-End box ('January 31 of each year') is checked, the signature is dated 1-30-2018, the clerk's RECEIVED IN OFFICE stamp reads JAN 30 2018, the Summary Page header is dated 1/30/2018, and BOTH filer attachments state their period in their own titles - 'Contributions January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2017' and 'Transaction List by Date / January through December 2017'. form_year records the printed title '2016' VERBATIM and must never be read as the cycle; this is the template-vintage-year class. The chunk file's FLAG on this filing is therefore CONFIRMED. Everything else in the chunk file/index.csv is confirmed too: BEN McADAMS, Mayor, year-end, date 2018-01-30 (the form writes it 1-30-2018). AMENDMENT: the 'No' box IS ticked here (unlike the other three filings in this chunk, where neither box is). STRUCTURE: both schedules are the 'attachment-behind-stub' shape - the county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p5) pages are present, each carries a single handwritten line 'see attached schedule' across the first grid row, each leaves SUBTOTAL blank and fills only TOTAL. MECHANICAL TRAP: p4 is a LANDSCAPE spreadsheet stored rotated inside a portrait page; its pct: geometry is converted BACK to the portrait frame poppler renders (each row is a tall narrow vertical box, x varying with row index, y=7.23 h=85.80), verified against the 90 dpi portrait thumbnail where the grand-total column sits at ~74.9%% and the computed box lands at 74.1-75.7%%. PRIVACY: on p4 a single black bar spans FOUR columns at once - Address, City, State AND Zipcode - so no donor geography survives; donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted at source'. The bar stops cleanly at the Zipcode/Employer boundary, so Employer and Occupation both survive. OCCUPATION: the attachment splits the county form's one 'Occupation/Employer' cell into TWO columns; both are captured, joined as 'Occupation: <x>; Employer: <y>'. 19 of the 38 rows have BOTH cells empty - the filer left them blank because those rows are organizations/PACs/corporations, not persons; that is a filer blank, NOT a redaction, and the row notes say so. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: the two crops were read independently and re-aligned by measured row band, then cross-checked semantically (David Brems / GSBS Architects, Bob Palais / Utah Valley University, Brett Okland / Okland Construction, Tom Love / Love Communications) - 38 dates, 38 names and 38 amounts, all aligned.

contributions.detail: 38 attachment rows sum to 48,500.00 = the attachment's own printed grand total (last row, '$ 48,500.00') = the county Schedule A stub's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED = Summary line 1 Column A (and Column B, identical). SCOPE TEST: the attachment header states its own period, 'January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2017', which is the period Column A covers - all three printed anchors share one scope. No in-kind rows and no in-kind marker anywhere on the attachment, so no schedule-total-vs-summary-gap.

expenditures.detail: 41 attachment rows sum to 32,425.81 = the attachment's printed foot total = the county Schedule B stub's printed TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE = Summary line 2 Column A (and Column B). The attachment header states 'January through December 2017' - same scope.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page-subtotal gate is available on either side: both county stub pages (p3, p5) leave 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' blank and fill only the TOTAL cell, and neither filer attachment prints per-page subtotals (each is a single page carrying one grand total). Gated instead on the attachment grand totals, which agree with the stubs' TOTAL cells and with the Summary Page: contributions 48,500.00 three ways; expenditures 32,425.81 three ways.
